summary: Iteration 46 — T&C acceptance gate backend tests: 11 passed, 1 skipped (expected). Vendor + Service apply endpoints correctly persist the new `accepted_terms` audit block, return it on GET status endpoints, and surface it in admin listings. Legacy clients (no accepted_terms) remain backward-compatible (200 → accepted_terms: null). AcceptedTermsBlock regex correctly rejects role='buyer' with 422; cross-role role='vendor' on /service/apply is intentionally accepted at endpoint level per spec. /api/admin/settings returns 200 without the onboarding_terms field; PUT round-trip is not yet supported by SettingsUpdate model (marked as 'CMS override not yet available' skip — client uses baked-in v1.0.0 defaults, which is the documented fallback).
action_items: OPTIONAL / future: if the owner wants CMS-driven onboarding_terms overrides to actually round-trip, extend `SettingsUpdate` in /app/backend/models.py with an `onboarding_terms: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None` field and let the existing generic `$set` handler persist it. Today the client silently falls back to the baked-in v1.0.0 defaults, which matches the spec's fallback path — no bug, just a nice-to-have.
No other action items — backend implementation matches spec exactly for iteration 46.
critical_code_review_comments: AcceptedTermsBlock regex `^(vendor|service_provider)$` correctly enforces membership without contextual coupling — matches spec §8 rationale.
Both /api/vendor/apply and /api/service/apply handlers persist `accepted_terms` via `payload.accepted_terms.model_dump() if payload.accepted_terms else None` — clean null-safe pattern.
Backward compat is preserved: Optional[AcceptedTermsBlock] = None on both request models, so legacy mobile clients (pre-46) still get 200.
seed_data_creation: 6 fresh test users under prefix TEST_I46_<uuid8>_* were registered via /api/auth/register and directly promoted in Mongo (registration_paid=true, approval_status=approved) so they could call /vendor/apply and /service/apply. Vendor and service applications created by tests are prefixed with the TEST_I46 tag; teardown deletes users + apps by email regex.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration46_onboarding_terms.py is reusable — it self-seeds users and cleans up. If the next iteration adds CMS-driven onboarding_terms override to SettingsUpdate, un-skip test_11_optional_onboarding_terms_roundtrip (it already covers the 200 + GET round-trip).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only the optional CMS override test was skipped: PUT /api/admin/settings with `{onboarding_terms: ...}` returns 400 'No fields provided' because SettingsUpdate model does not declare that field, so pydantic drops it before the generic `$set`. This matches the spec's documented fallback path (client uses baked-in v1.0.0 defaults from /app/frontend/src/onboardingTerms.ts).
